reason: The break is already the shipped default and so is not injectable: the run block's embedder_model.build_default reads Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, parsed out of the build's own source, which is English-only. summary: arm D: an English-only embedder where a multilingual one is expected — the six cross-lingual MUST lanes should catch it
